name: React Kanban with Fluent UI & LocalStorage

userStories.title: Project Scaffolding & Fluent UI Setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to initialize the React application with Fluent UI so that I have a solid foundation for UI development.
acceptanceCriteria: Setup a basic layout shell (Header + Main Content area)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement Data Service (LocalStorage)
userStories.description: As a user, I want my data to be saved automatically so that I don't lose work when I refresh the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a `StorageService` to handle Read/Write operations
Implement `loadData()` to retrieve state from LocalStorage
Seed default data if storage is empty

userStories.title: Board Layout & Columns
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the five specific workflow columns so that I can visualize the process.
acceptanceCriteria: Layout is responsive (scrollable on smaller screens)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create New Task
userStories.description: As a user, I want to add new tasks to the "Backlog" so that I can capture work items.
acceptanceCriteria: "Add Task" button present (global or top of Backlog column)
New task appears immediately in the "Backlog" column
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Task Card & Markdown Rendering
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view task details with formatting so that information is easy to read.
acceptanceCriteria: Task cards display Title, ID, and Due Date (if set)
Task descriptions support Markdown rendering (bold, list, links)
Card styling matches Fluent UI design language
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Drag and Drop Implementation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to move tasks between columns by dragging so that I can update their status intuitively.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks can be dragged from one column to another
Dropping a task updates its status/column
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Task Details & Editing
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit task details, including tags and due dates, so that I can keep information current.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a task opens a Detail Panel/Dialog
User can edit Title and Description
User can select a Due Date via date picker
"Save" updates the task on the board and in storage
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Settings & Webhook Configuration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure a webhook URL so that I can send notifications to my chat app.
acceptanceCriteria: "Test Webhook" button to send a dummy payload
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Webhook Triggers
userStories.description: As a user, I want notifications sent automatically when tasks are completed so that my team is aware.
acceptanceCriteria: System detects when a task is dropped into the "Done" column
System sends a POST request to the configured Webhook URL
Payload includes Task Title and Status
Handle errors gracefully (e.g., if URL is invalid, don't crash app)

userStories.title: Progress Dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a summary of progress so that I know how the project is doing.
acceptanceCriteria: Display total count of tasks per column
Show a simple progress bar (Ratio of "Done" tasks vs Total)
Update metrics in real-time as tasks move
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
